project_type: AWS CDK TypeScript infrastructure + React SPA + Lambda backend (greenfield platform module)
build_system: npm for CDK and React frontend, Python for Lambda
test_framework: Jest for TypeScript/React, CDK assertions for infrastructure
verification_instructions: 1. npm install in platform/, 2. npm run build succeeds, 3. cdk synth produces valid CloudFormation, 4. npm test passes
snapshot_or_generated_files: CDK generates cdk.out/ with CloudFormation templates on cdk synth. Not checked in.
setup_instructions: 1. cd platform && npm install, 2. cd platform/frontend && npm install, 3. cdk bootstrap (for first deploy)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full npm/pip access. Node.js v22 available. Python 3.9 available. AWS CDK installable via npm.
contribution_requirements: Existing infra/ and scripts/ directories must remain untouched. The new platform/ directory is self-contained. Recipes and compose files are referenced by path from the parent repo.
key_patterns: Existing patterns from the repo: 1) Capacity poller uses probe-then-launch (direct launch for B300 due to <20s windows). 2) Docker compose files define deployment topologies with network_mode: host, port 30080. 3) Recipes are .env files that configure model/tp/speculative params. 4) Bootstrap script handles NVMe RAID, model download, docker setup. 5) SUBNET_MAP in handler.py maps AZs to verified subnets. 6) Instance profile: tpot-bench-ec2-profile, SG: tpot-bench-noingress-sg. 7) Account: 077090643075.
directory_structure: platform/ (new, self-contained): CDK app at root, frontend/ for React SPA, lambda/ for Python handlers. References ../scripts/ for compose files and recipes.
